description: Source code for handling git bundle creation, verification, and unbundling, including parsing headers, writing bundle data, and managing references.

methods.name: bundle_header_init
methods.description: Initializes a bundle_header structure with default values.

methods.name: bundle_header_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a bundle_header structure.

methods.name: parse_capability
methods.description: Parses a capability string and updates the bundle header accordingly.

methods.name: parse_bundle_signature
methods.description: Parses the bundle signature line to determine version.

methods.name: read_bundle_header_fd
methods.description: Reads and parses the bundle header from a file descriptor.

methods.name: read_bundle_header
methods.description: Reads and parses the bundle header from a file path.

methods.name: is_bundle
methods.description: Checks if a file is a valid bundle.

methods.name: list_refs
methods.description: Lists references from a string list, optionally filtered by arguments.

methods.name: verify_bundle
methods.description: Verifies the integrity and prerequisites of a bundle.

methods.name: list_bundle_refs
methods.description: Lists references contained in a bundle header.

methods.name: is_tag_in_date_range
methods.description: Checks if a tag object is within the specified date range.

methods.name: write_pack_data
methods.description: Writes pack data to the bundle file descriptor based on revision info.

methods.name: write_bundle_refs
methods.description: Writes references to the bundle file descriptor.

methods.name: write_bundle_prerequisites
methods.description: Writes prerequisite commits into the bundle.

methods.name: create_bundle
methods.description: Creates a new bundle file from a repository with specified options.

methods.name: unbundle
methods.description: Unbundles a bundle file into a repository, verifying and processing the bundle.
